what_it_is: Enterprise AI security: asset discovery, model scanning, red teaming, runtime guardrails and agent identity.
identity_note: Scope is Cisco AI Defense (includes Robust Intelligence technology), Duo Agentic Identity, Secure Access AI Access and Astrix Security, now part of Cisco.

1.reason: AI Inventory finds AWS Bedrock, SageMaker and AgentCore assets (beta). Secure Access finds shadow AI by network.
1.evidence: Assets are discovered from AWS Bedrock, SageMaker, and AgentCore.
1.has: AI Inventory, cisco-aibom CLI, Secure Access AI Access for shadow AI.
1.lacks: Docs list AWS discovery in beta. Network-only shadow AI. No cloud misconfiguration checks.

2.reason: MCP Catalog, server scanning and runtime allow and block lists. Agent runtime guards for AgentCore, Vertex and Foundry.
2.evidence: Runtime policies now enforce tool allowlists and blocklists, automatically restricting MCP server or tool usage
2.has: MCP Catalog, MCP scanning, runtime allow and block lists. Agent SDK for three platforms.
2.lacks: No agent sandbox. Tool-call policy runs at a proxy, not the host.

3.reason: AI Runtime blocks attacks and sends events to Splunk and ServiceNow. No host-level blocking.
3.evidence: The Cisco AI Defense integration for ServiceNow brings AI asset and security information from Cisco AI Defense into ServiceNow
3.has: Splunk and ServiceNow AI Control Tower integrations. Inline block of prompts and tool calls.
3.lacks: No control-plane log detection or auto-remediation workflow. Blocks at network, not host.

4.reason: AI Runtime inspects prompts and responses via API, SDK, gateway, Multicloud Defense and LiteLLM.
4.evidence: AI Runtime inspects all prompts and responses to block violations.
4.has: AI Runtime via API, SDK, gateway, LiteLLM, Multicloud Defense. PII, injection, code, safety rules.

5.reason: Findings map to NIST AI RMF, MITRE ATLAS and OWASP. cisco-aibom outputs JSON or text.
5.evidence: Starting in AI Defense 26.9.3, we show these mappings in the AI Red Teaming Deep Dive for each attack.
5.has: Standards mappings to OWASP, NIST, MITRE. PDF scan reports. cisco-aibom CLI.
5.lacks: AIBOM output documented as JSON or text. CycloneDX or SPDX not documented.

6.reason: Algorithmic red teaming runs 200+ techniques, multi-turn attacks, scheduled runs and OWASP, NIST, MITRE mapping.
6.evidence: You can now schedule red-teaming tests to run automatically at the frequency that fits your use case
6.has: AI Red Teaming (ex-Validation): 200+ techniques, multi-turn, agents, scheduled and CI/CD runs.

7.reason: Duo Agentic Identity registers agents and authorizes each tool call. Astrix, now Cisco, governs NHIs.
7.evidence: enforced at every tool call through a gateway that intercepts agent requests and evaluates them
7.has: Duo Agentic Identity per-tool authorization. Astrix NHI discovery for keys, service accounts, OAuth.
7.lacks: Per-agent cryptographic credential not documented. Duo link to AI Defense is coming soon.

8.reason: Model Scanning covers 10 format families incl. Pickle, GGUF, ONNX, SafeTensors. Dataset and code checks are narrower.
8.evidence: AI Defense detects threats in AI model files during supply chain scanning.
8.has: Model Scanning for 10 format families, MCP Scanner, cisco-aibom source analysis.
8.lacks: Dataset PII scanning not documented. No general LLM-risk code scanner.

notes: Robust Intelligence (acquired 2024) is the base of AI Defense algorithmic red teaming and guardrails. Cisco completed the Astrix Security acquisition on 2026-06-29 (NHI security for API keys, service accounts, OAuth tokens). Cisco announced intent to acquire Galileo (AI observability), not scored. Splunk is a Cisco company. Validation was renamed AI Red Teaming on 2026-09-02. The Toxicity rule was removed on 2026-09-16 and replaced by granular Safety rules (hate, harassment, profanity, violence). Caveats: the data sheet (updated 2026-05-21) says discovery spans Bedrock, Vertex and Azure AI Foundry, but the user guide documents AWS only and marks it beta, and CloudTrail change detection is marked coming soon. Duo Agentic Identity launched at RSAC 2026. Duo works with Cisco Secure Access, AgentGateway, Envoy and AWS AgentCore Gateway today, and the AI Defense integration is coming soon. Multi-modality red teaming (text, audio, image) is single-turn only. Unsure points: 3.2 scored partial because automated remediation is not documented beyond runtime blocking. 7.1 scored partial because agents register as owner-linked identities with short-lived tokens, and a per-agent cryptographic credential is not documented.
